style: A research team's whiteboard: heavy Albert Sans over Shantell Sans marker writing, sticky notes in yellow, pink, blue and green that slap onto the wall and can be dragged around, taped service cards, red marker squiggles and arrows.

concept.idea: Voice-of-customer research ends on a wall of sticky notes sorted into themes, so the site is that wall: specialties are notes, services are taped cards, proof is what was overheard, and the method ends with sorting it on the wall.
concept.signature: The hero wall: six specialty notes slap on one after another, one lifts its corner every few seconds at rest, and on a desktop the visitor can pick any note up and move it. A tidy finished wall without JS or with reduced motion.

jury.note: Self-score from the /jury rubric and shoot.mjs evidence (0 axe violations, no horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440 with sample and long.json, no tap target under 24 px, every focus stop visible, skip link first, nothing moving under reduced motion). No blind critic was run for this batch. The sticky-note wall is specific to voice-of-customer work and you can drag the notes on a desktop. On a phone the notes fall into a tidy grid and lose the scatter, and the handwritten face is used a lot.
